Summary: Jimmy Fallon delivers a monologue on The Tonight Show, poking fun at Donald Trump appointing Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff and mispronouncing the word 'genome'. He also jokes about CERN scientists discovering the 'zeptoverse', Rice Krispies recipe changes, and celebrates the arrival of the Rockefeller Center Christmas tree alongside guest Robert De Niro.
People: Jimmy Fallon; Donald Trump; Stephen Miller; Susie Wiles; Robert De Niro; Ariana Grande; Marco Rubio
